decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - It is considered that the proposed change of use from staff accommodation on first floor to office/store incorporating internal alteration, because of its location, use and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 373 Hatton Road, Bedfont would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the area or the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance the development is in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-N.1.1 (Purposes of including land in and objectives for the use of land in the Green Belt), ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable development in the Green Belt), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments), T.4.6 (Off-street parking) and T.6.7 (Public safety zones and other operational constraints).
description: Change of use from staff accommodation on first floor to office/store incorporating internal alteration
